name: ix_audit_events_created_at
sql: CREATE INDEX ix_audit_events_created_at ON audit_events (created_at)

name: ix_audit_owner_created
sql: CREATE INDEX ix_audit_owner_created ON audit_events (actor_ref, created_at)

name: ix_audit_trace
sql: CREATE INDEX ix_audit_trace ON audit_events (trace_id)

name: ix_connector_health_checks_connector_id
sql: CREATE INDEX ix_connector_health_checks_connector_id ON connector_health_checks (connector_id)

name: ix_connector_health_checks_created_at
sql: CREATE INDEX ix_connector_health_checks_created_at ON connector_health_checks (created_at)

name: ix_connector_status
sql: CREATE INDEX ix_connector_status ON connectors (status)

name: ix_memory_subject
sql: CREATE INDEX ix_memory_subject ON user_memories (app_id, subject, kind)

name: ix_module_app_key
sql: CREATE INDEX ix_module_app_key ON module_definitions (app_id, module_key)

name: ix_skills_app_id
sql: CREATE INDEX ix_skills_app_id ON skills (app_id)

name: ix_tool_connector_status
sql: CREATE INDEX ix_tool_connector_status ON tool_definitions (connector_id, status)

name: ix_tool_switches_app_id
sql: CREATE INDEX ix_tool_switches_app_id ON tool_switches (app_id)

name: ix_tool_test_runs_tool_id
sql: CREATE INDEX ix_tool_test_runs_tool_id ON tool_test_runs (tool_id)

name: ix_user_memories_expires_at
sql: CREATE INDEX ix_user_memories_expires_at ON user_memories (expires_at)

name: uq_published_mcp_name
sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_published_mcp_name ON tool_definitions (mcp_name) WHERE status = 'published'

name: admin_application_scopes
sql:
CREATE TABLE admin_application_scopes (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	app_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_admin_application_scope UNIQUE (user_id, app_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES admin_users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(app_id) REFERENCES applications (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

name: admin_sessions
sql:
CREATE TABLE admin_sessions (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	csrf_token VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES admin_users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	UNIQUE (token_hash)
)

name: admin_users
sql:
CREATE TABLE admin_users (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR(320) NOT NULL, 
	password_hash VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	totp_secret_encrypted TEXT, 
	mfa_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, last_totp_counter INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (email)
)

name: alembic_version
sql:
CREATE TABLE alembic_version (
	version_num VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT alembic_version_pkc PRIMARY KEY (version_num)
)

name: applications
sql:
CREATE TABLE applications (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	"key" VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	environment VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_key VARCHAR(64), 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_application_key_env UNIQUE ("key", environment)
)

name: audit_events
sql:
CREATE TABLE audit_events (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	trace_id VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	actor_ref VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	app_key VARCHAR(64), 
	module_key VARCHAR(64), 
	tool_key VARCHAR(120), 
	environment VARCHAR(32), 
	result VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	error_code VARCHAR(64), 
	duration_ms INTEGER, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, retry_count INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

name: chat_settings
sql:
CREATE TABLE "chat_settings" (
	app_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	provider VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	model VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	effort VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	instructions TEXT NOT NULL, 
	welcome_message VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	suggestions JSON NOT NULL, 
	max_steps INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	daily_limit INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (app_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(app_id) REFERENCES applications (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

name: connector_health_checks
sql:
CREATE TABLE connector_health_checks (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	connector_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	latency_ms INTEGER, 
	error_category VARCHAR(64), 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(connector_id) REFERENCES connectors (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

name: connector_secrets
sql:
CREATE TABLE connector_secrets (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	connector_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	secret_ciphertext TEXT NOT NULL, 
	delegation_ciphertext TEXT NOT NULL, 
	rotated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	revoked_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(connector_id) REFERENCES connectors (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

name: connectors
sql:
CREATE TABLE connectors (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	app_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	connector_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	base_url VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	manifest_path VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	health_path VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	auth_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	tls_verify BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	timeout_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	failure_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	circuit_open_until DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(app_id) REFERENCES applications (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	UNIQUE (app_id)
)

name: contract_snapshots
sql:
CREATE TABLE contract_snapshots (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	connector_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	manifest_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	manifest_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	manifest_json JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_contract_snapshot UNIQUE (connector_id, manifest_hash), 
	FOREIGN KEY(connector_id) REFERENCES connectors (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

name: field_policies
sql:
CREATE TABLE field_policies (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	module_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	field_path VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	classification VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	locked BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(module_id) REFERENCES module_definitions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_field_policy UNIQUE (module_id, field_path)
)

name: memory_settings
sql:
CREATE TABLE memory_settings (
	app_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	retention_days INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	max_notes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (app_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(app_id) REFERENCES applications (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

name: mfa_challenges
sql:
CREATE TABLE mfa_challenges (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	purpose VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	used_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES admin_users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

name: model_providers
sql:
CREATE TABLE model_providers (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	"key" VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	base_url VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	auth_style VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	auth_header VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	api_key_ciphertext TEXT NOT NULL, 
	api_key_hint VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	headers JSON NOT NULL, 
	token_param VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	tool_schema VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	streaming BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	default_model VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	models JSON NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	status_message VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	checked_at DATETIME, 
	created_by VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE ("key")
)

name: module_definitions
sql:
CREATE TABLE module_definitions (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	app_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	module_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	description VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	schema_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	manifest_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	manifest_json JSON NOT NULL, 
	supported_operations JSON NOT NULL, 
	readable_fields JSON NOT NULL, 
	writable_fields JSON NOT NULL, 
	filters JSON NOT NULL, 
	max_page_size INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	risk JSON NOT NULL, 
	last_synced_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(app_id) REFERENCES applications (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_module_app_key UNIQUE (app_id, module_key)
)

name: module_settings
sql:
CREATE TABLE module_settings (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	module_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	operations_enabled JSON NOT NULL, 
	policy_version INTEGER NOT NULL, report_endpoint VARCHAR(320), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(module_id) REFERENCES module_definitions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	UNIQUE (module_id)
)

name: rest_tool_mappings
sql:
CREATE TABLE rest_tool_mappings (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	connector_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	method VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	path_template VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	timeout_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	max_payload_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	query_params JSON NOT NULL, 
	pagination JSON NOT NULL, 
	safe_query BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	requires_user_context BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	tenant_field VARCHAR(64), 
	audit_level VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, error_mapping JSON DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(connector_id) REFERENCES connectors (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

name: service_identities
sql:
CREATE TABLE service_identities (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	app_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	scopes JSON NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME, 
	revoked_at DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, allowed_tools JSON, last_used_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(app_id) REFERENCES applications (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	UNIQUE (token_hash)
)

name: skills
sql:
CREATE TABLE skills (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	app_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	"key" VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	description VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	instructions TEXT NOT NULL, 
	arguments JSON NOT NULL, 
	tools JSON NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_by VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_skill_app_key UNIQUE (app_id, "key"), 
	FOREIGN KEY(app_id) REFERENCES applications (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

name: tool_definitions
sql:
CREATE TABLE "tool_definitions" (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tool_key VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	mcp_name VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	connector_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	mapping_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	module_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	description VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	input_schema JSON NOT NULL, 
	output_schema JSON NOT NULL, 
	output_policy JSON NOT NULL, 
	risk VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	approved_by VARCHAR(36), 
	content_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	policy_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, template VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT 'read' NOT NULL, title VARCHAR(120), report_spec JSON, updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_tool_connector_key_version UNIQUE (connector_id, tool_key, version), 
	FOREIGN KEY(connector_id) REFERENCES connectors (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(mapping_id) REFERENCES rest_tool_mappings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

name: tool_switches
sql:
CREATE TABLE tool_switches (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	app_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tool_name VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	updated_by VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_tool_switch_app_tool UNIQUE (app_id, tool_name), 
	FOREIGN KEY(app_id) REFERENCES applications (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

name: tool_test_runs
sql:
CREATE TABLE tool_test_runs (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tool_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	mode VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	passed BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	trace_id VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	duration_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	error_code VARCHAR(64), 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, content_hash VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, case_results JSON DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tool_id) REFERENCES tool_definitions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

name: user_memories
sql:
CREATE TABLE user_memories (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	app_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	subject VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	"key" VARCHAR(40), 
	content_ciphertext TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(app_id) REFERENCES applications (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
